title: REPROBE Manifest
description: Disclosure manifest for a single LLM agent benchmark run. Schema version 0.1.

reprobe_version.description: Schema version this manifest conforms to (semver).

result_id.description: Stable identifier for this result. Convention: <benchmark>-<model>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.

version.description: Release tag or version string of the benchmark.

commit.description: Optional commit hash of the canonical benchmark repository at evaluation time.

subset.description: 'full' or the name of a declared subset (e.g., 'first-100', 'lite', 'sampled').

subset_rule.description: Rule for subset selection (e.g., 'first', 'random_seed_42', 'stratified_by_difficulty'). Required if subset != 'full'.

grader_version.description: Version tag or commit hash of the grader code, OR a hash of the LLM-judge prompt.

partial_credit.description: Whether the grader awards partial credit for partial task completion.

harness.description: Harness / scaffold specification. May be null for non-agent evaluations.

scaffold_version.description: Version tag or commit hash of the scaffold.

system_prompt.description: Verbatim system prompt. Prefer system_prompt_hash for large prompts.

system_prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the verbatim system prompt.

tools.description: List of tool names available to the agent.

max_steps.description: Maximum agent steps before forced stop.

max_tokens.description: Optional global token cap for the agent loop.

container_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the environment image, e.g., 'sha256:abc...'. Mutable tags should NOT be used here.

container_tag.description: Optional mutable tag for human readability. Reproducibility relies on container_digest, not this field.

engine.description: Inference engine for open-weights models (e.g., 'vllm-0.5.0', 'transformers-4.40'). Null for hosted APIs.

seed.description: Random seed if exposed by the provider. Null is an explicit declaration that the seed is not exposed (do not omit the field).

passes_per_task.description: Number of inference passes per task. >1 implies an aggregation rule.

aggregation.description: Aggregation across passes. Required if passes_per_task > 1.

verifier_for_best_of_n.description: If aggregation == 'best_of_n', the verifier model/method identifier.

run_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the evaluation was run. Required for closed-API correlation against provider changelogs.

rate_source.description: URL or identifier of the pricing page used to compute dollar_cost_usd.

failures.description: Structured per-task failure breakdown. Keys are category names; values are integer counts.

headline_metric.description: The single number this manifest is attached to.
